user.title: Z2M Device Tracker
user.description: Connects to the Z2M Device Tracker app, which records every Zigbee2MQTT device's history. Adds summary sensors and the z2m-tracker-card. The app URL is filled in automatically when the app is installed.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Z2M Device Tracker is already set up.

data_description.repairs: Mirrors the app's warnings and the checks set to notify. Each one clears itself when the problem is fixed.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Ask the app to re-scan Z2M databases, configuration backups, logs and Home Assistant registries for devices and names, and merge them into the history.
